compliance.status: adopted HEFSP; multiple rounds of obligation settled; Fourth Round obligation set by Decision and Order May 13, 2025

notes: DCA obligation: present_need=36, prospective_need=629. Township calculated prospective need=444. Township mediated with FSHC and agreed to prospective need=495. Decision and Order entered May 13, 2025. Township is in NJ Highlands — Highlands Build-Out analysis yields RDP=3 affordable units; build-out unmet need=492. Fourth Round Obligation = 495 as confirmed by Resolution #159-25 (March 24, 2025). FSHC Settlement agreement dated June 8, 2018; Amended Settlement Agreement Oct 11, 2022; Second Amendment July 23, 2024. Fourth Round compliance mechanisms: 457 Ridge Road (Block 139 Lot 41, ~74 affordable, MF-3 Overlay, board-approved), 1 Fyke Road (Block 21 Lots 21-23, MF-1 Zone), 70 Island Road (MF-2 Zone, 100% affordable under construction, 15 units projected), Block 70 Lots 37+38 (100% affordable, Redevelopment Plan), Block 70 Lot 40 (inclusionary, Redevelopment Plan), group homes (Stag Hill/Jahn/Strong), Block 82 Redevelopment, and Franklin Turnpike overlay (Block 71 Lots 6-22). CORRECTION to candidate snapshot: prospective_need candidate had 629 (DCA figure); settled obligation is 495.
